stories.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86

en.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
en.summary: Jeffrey Archer, a prolific author who sold over 300 million books during his writing career, has died at 86. His final book was scheduled for release later this month.
